scope: Complete conceptual plumb-and-circle instrument on a visible tilting support. Glass enclosure is an explicit assumed embodiment of the text’s wind shielding.

joints.notes: Support world origin [0,0.06,0]. Deck centre and roll axis are world [0,0.22,0], with a shaft along Z. Rotate the deck around its own centre, without duplicating the pivot translation.
Gravity-defined quasi-static counterrotation to deck. Not a gear. q_plumb=-q_deck for slow display only.

input_rate.note: Maximum angular rate of deck-roll, imposed by an assumed exhibition handler.

drive.justification: A slow tilt demonstrates gravity reference. Pendulum follows quasi-static vertical, not a simulated aircraft turn.

phases.name: Slow left and right tilt
phases.interpolation: Explicit sine, radians, phase-local t in seconds. Quasi-static gravity assumption.

motion.visitor_12s: One slow tilt left and right through±10degrees. The thread stays vertical in the room.

animation_notes: No undocumented flight, lift, bounce, mechanism or invisible reset.
Gravity pendulum does not indicate true attitude during arbitrary acceleration. Do not present it as a modern artificial horizon.
Counterrotation is quasi-static presentation. No added pendulum oscillation or spring. The fixture is visibly a display support.

At +/-10 degrees the lowest point of the deck is above world Y=0.158 m, clearing fixed support top Y=0.12 m. Fixed journals at |Z|=0.28 m clear deck radius 0.24 m. The thread connector meets the dome crown and pendulum pivot. Its bob remains inside the wind shield throughout the slow counterrotation.

research.identification: CA 1058r, distinct from 1058v parachute. Folio number and literal text verified in e-Leo and museum catalogue. Holder-specific catalogue extraction remains unavailable [s-folio,s-model,s-holder].
sheet_vs_reconstruction: A ball or plumb reference inside a circle is to guide level or inclined travel. Text asks to keep wind off it [s-folio].
IBM Italia 1952 supplies a glass bell and detailed circular base. This dossier assumes its own geometry for wind shielding [s-model,a-geometry].

dimensions.quote: non ci vuol dare il vento
dimensions.conversion: No linear dimension supplied for this instrument in the inspected text. All geometry C.

claims.claimed: Centre the ball in the circle for level travel and learn by experiment [s-folio].
claims.tested: Instruction to try it, not a recorded completed test [s-folio].
claims.built_lifetime: No instrument from Leonardo’s lifetime located.
claims.later: IBM 1952 museum reconstruction, no flight calibration reported [s-model].

physics.formula: Static angular indication uses gravity. Point-mass small-angle periodT=2*pi*sqrt(L/g). Apparent gravity under horizontal acceleration tilts byatan(a/g).
physics.inputs: L 0.24 m,g 9.81 m/s 2,a 2 m/s 2 are a-physics.
physics.results: Free period 0.983 s. A 10 degree roll displaces the bob relative to the suspension vertical byL*sin(10 deg)=0.0417 m. Sustained 2 m/s 2 horizontal acceleration tilts apparent gravity 11.52 degrees even without a true platform roll.
physics.limitations: Display assumes negligible acceleration.12 s tilt is a quasi-static didactic motion, not dynamically exact. This pendulum cannot be a universal aircraft attitude reference.
physics.verdict_en: A plumb line shows gravity direction, which acceleration can deflect.
physics.verdict_de: Ein Lot zeigt die Richtung der scheinbaren Schwerkraft, die sich bei Beschleunigung ändert.

myths.claim: Leonardo built the first artificial horizon.
myths.correction: The sheet shows a gravity reference. No lifetime flight test or acceleration-independent horizon is documented [s-folio].

research.confidence: High primary transcription and folio identity. Holder catalogue technical access gap remains explicit. Low historical build certainty. Complete assumed conceptual geometry.

geometry_validation.method: Local primitive and mesh geometry transformed through the specified joint hierarchy. Forty-nine poses across 12 seconds, or one static pose. Tube centreline bounds conservatively expanded by radius. Analytic motion extrema and attachment clearances are given in animation_notes.
geometry_validation.result: All tested swept points are inside the declared conservative bounding box. Geometry defines a C exhibit interpretation, not structural certification.
